notes: Troubleshooting v356 fixes a startup freeze observed when opening the Troubleshooting page from a browser/PWA with a large saved ServoForge workspace. The page now shields its startup path from the full labelerToolSettings payload and uses a compact troubleshooting-context snapshot instead, while a Web Worker refreshes that snapshot off the main UI thread for subsequent visits. Browser startup also uses a lightweight runtime smoke validation rather than the full recursive engineering validation suite; the complete source/library validation remains enforced by CI and is retained as fullValidate for engineering diagnostics. A four-second startup watchdog replaces an indefinite Loading diagnostic library state with an actionable error if initialization ever fails. v355 APL Cart source logic and all existing troubleshooting fault-isolation behavior remain unchanged.
